instructions.content: NEVER paste an entire category's list into a journal entry, ticket comment, or status update — cite only the 1-3 aphorisms that actually fit the situation.
NEVER treat this skill as authority for a stakeholder-facing regulatory, legal, or prize-dispute decision — route those to Legal, Compliance, or the DPO.
NEVER force a citation when nothing in the matched category actually fits the situation — say so plainly and skip it.
Identify the trigger scenario first, then load only the matching references/*.md category file — never load more than one category per invocation.
Attribute any quoted aphorism to Madden/LLIS #1956 and apply it explicitly to the concrete case at hand, not as a floating quote.
Skip this skill entirely when the situation doesn't match a trigger scenario in the When to Use table, rather than forcing a fit.
